name: Kegareta Seifuku Hakusho Vol.1 ~Shimai, Mukareru~
original_name: 汚れた制服白書 Vol.1 ～姉妹、剥かれる～
source:
A female English teacher working has a bad relationship with her sister. They used to be close, but can't find common grounds recently. They argue over a trifle and separate at the station, but there is an insidious trap waiting for them in the train car...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位正在工作的女英语老师和她的妹妹关系不好。他们曾经很亲密，但最近却找不到共同点。他们在车站因小事争吵而分开，但车厢里却有一个阴险的陷阱在等着他们……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
